decisions.reason: After several years with no visible follow-up and in a more standardized HVAC segment, management would likely judge this line as not clearly meeting aspiration and reallocate resources despite its technical fit.

Its earlier signal of major market share in marine water cooling puts it above aspiration, and a German engineering firm would usually retain such a core marine system even if later website visibility is lower.
The marine cooling unit remains close to established marine capabilities and can be bundled into broader system offerings, so available slack and strategic fit still favor continuation.

Although the lack of later visibility raises some concern, the compact oil cooler is adjacent to the core exchanger business and can still be justified as a niche line serving existing channels and customers.

As a more component-like product with no observed continued market prominence, it is more likely to have fallen below aspiration and to be sacrificed in problemistic reallocation toward stronger businesses.

Enhanced tubes fit the firm's R&D path, but if standalone market traction remains unclear after several years the firm would likely redeploy the knowledge into other exchanger products rather than keep this offer separate.
